name: icon-button
title: Icon button
summary: An action shown only as an icon, in a circle the size of the target.
use: For actions everyone recognizes by their icon: close, more, previous, next, theme.

options.name: variant
options.description: outline has a hairline ring; ghost has none and suits toolbars and fields.

options.name: label
options.description: Required. Read by assistive technology and shown as a tooltip.

options.name: isOn
options.description: A toggle's on state, or the open pane a toolbar button stands for: ink on surface.

rules: Never use an icon button for an action whose icon needs explaining; use a button with a label.
An on state is surface and ink; never the accent.
outline is a round raised cap; ghost is flat. Pressed or on, both sit pressed into a well.
accessibility: A target of 44 × 44pt, or 28 × 28pt at compact density.
An on button has the selected trait.
